entities.name: Cridhe
entities.description: A small plane composed mostly of a single island, created by the Maker and home to humans and elves, setting of the novel The Cursed Land.

entities.name: Maker
aliases: the god who created this plane
entities.description: A being who created Cridhe and whose ancient curse came true at the Parting.

entities.name: Clan Tree
entities.description: The heart of the plane, containing all of its mana; destroyed in the Parting and recreated in the Mending.

entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: Wizard who destroyed the Clan Tree trying to become a planeswalker, cursing himself and his descendants with madness.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: Instigated Nohr's destruction of the tree.

entities.name: Haen
entities.description: Ancestor of the Heanish who foretold the Mending of the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Keeper, descendant of Haen, who broke the curse on Nazir and helped mend the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Healed wizard and Felonarch, descendant of Nohr, who had a prophetic vision and helped mend the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Crephas
entities.description: Created lumini, makana and the ardre fungus; went mad before engineering the Albions.

entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: Residence of the Heanish in the central mountainous region.

entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: Residence of the Nohrish on the east coast.

entities.name: The Parting
entities.description: The destruction of the tree around 3043 AR that split the isle in two and plunged the plane into a climate crisis.

entities.name: The Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: The recreation of the Clan Tree 520 years after the Parting.

entities.name: Long Winter
entities.description: A cold period caused by the erratic seasons after the Parting.

events.summary: Instigated by Malvos, Nohr destroys the Clan Tree trying to become a planeswalker; the isle splits in two and Nohr and his descendants are cursed with madness.
events.quote: the wizard Nohr destroyed the tree trying to become a planeswalker

events.summary: After the Parting, clouds obscure the sun and the climate collapses; crops wither and Nohrland dies.
events.quote: Clouds immediately obscured the sun, creating a permanent daily twilight and nightly darkness.

events.summary: In Year 520, Aylith and Nazir mend the Clan Tree and the seasons return to normal.
events.quote: Keeper Aylith and Felonarch Nazir descendants of Haen and Nohr, mended the Clan Tree .

events.summary: Aylith breaks the curse on Nazir and together they recreate the Clan Tree from the last acorn, fulfilling Haen's prophecy.
participants: The Mending of the Clan Tree
events.quote: the Keeper Aylith used her powers to break the curse on Nazir .

events.summary: Nazir has a prophetic vision of what the plane will look like in 1000 years.
events.quote: the healed wizard Nazir had a prophetic vision of what the plane would look like 1000 years in the future

relations.quote: Cridhe was created by a being called the Maker
the wizard Nohr destroyed the tree

relations.note: Instigated Nohr to destroy the tree.
Broke his curse and mended the tree with him.
relations.quote: Together they spoke the litany of light
